plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Digital Media Production (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, 'Version 2026/04/03', College of Performing Arts and Social Sciences. The PDF prints both new and old course numbers (old DMD numbers are pre-2026 renumbering, shown for reference); the new 2026-2027 MCOM/DMPR numbers are used as codes. CREDIT RANGES, lower bound applied at slot level per standing rules: Junior Fall has one Directed Elective at 1-3 cr, Junior Spring has two Directed Electives at 1-3 cr, Senior Spring has one Directed Elective at 1-3 cr -- each recorded at 1 credit, documented in choice_note. Sequenced sum 16+16+16+16+13+11+15+11 = 114. GENUINE CATALOG TOTAL DISCREPANCY, kept verbatim and documented (verified via pdftotext -layout): the PDF prints grand TOTAL 120, with Junior Fall and Junior Spring printing 13-15 and Senior Spring printing 12; total_credits reflects the sequenced sum. Catalog footnote: DMD 1343 Media Writing (MCOM 26103) and DMD 1221 Media Practicum (MCOM 12201) must be taken concurrently. 'Social Science', 'Fine Arts and Humanities', 'Natural Science', 'Math', 'Directed Elective', 'Minor Course', 'Minor/Elective Course', and 'Elective Course' name only the slot, not a course: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true. 'PR = pre-requisite.'
